Pack.Title: Awkward Heroics
Pack.Description: Dry humor, awkwardly competent moments, and mechanically serious consequences for critical attacks, spell attacks, and saving throws.

Errors.Registration: Awkward Heroics could not be registered with PF2E Critical Forge. See the console for details.

BetterThanPlanned.Title: Better Than Planned
BetterThanPlanned.Description: The hit is technically flawless. The target has objections, but currently not a particularly convincing defense.

ConvincingArgument.Title: Convincing Argument
ConvincingArgument.Description: It was not a conversation, but the message arrived. The target briefly questions how the rest of this is going to go.

StillInMotion.Title: Still in Motion
StillInMotion.Description: The strike ends exactly where the next good idea can begin. That is rarely convenient, but this time it is.

ThatWasTheGap.Title: That Was the Gap
ThatWasTheGap.Description: It is now perfectly clear where the defense does not work. Unfortunately for the target, the demonstration was conducted live.

BriefReassessment.Title: Brief Reassessment
BriefReassessment.Description: The target reevaluates its attacking technique. The current assessment is unexpectedly critical.

FirmlyWorded.Title: Firmly Worded
FirmlyWorded.Description: The strike temporarily removes some of the strength the target had been using with considerable confidence.

StanceCorrection.Title: Stance Correction
StanceCorrection.Description: The target's stance undergoes an involuntary revision. The result is functional, but not elegant.

GoodPostureForNow.Title: Good Posture, for Now
GoodPostureForNow.Description: The motion is clean enough that the attacker briefly appears defensively organized as well.

NowWeKnowTheSpot.Title: Now We Know the Spot
NowWeKnowTheSpot.Description: The hit identifies a weak point with persuasive clarity. Everyone involved may briefly make use of that information.

UnnecessarilyClean.Title: Unnecessarily Clean
UnnecessarilyClean.Description: The hit lands with a level of precision nobody requested. Confidence accepts the bonus anyway.

ExcellentLine.Title: Excellent Line
ExcellentLine.Description: The attack arrives from an angle that briefly ruins the target's view of the situation. Very educational, probably later.

PlanConfirmed.Title: Plan Confirmed
PlanConfirmed.Description: Apparently the idea was sound. This rare realization steadies the attacker for the next unpleasant surprise.

TechnicallyAnAttack.Title: Technically an Attack
TechnicallyAnAttack.Description: The motion meets the minimum requirements for an attack. The defense, unfortunately, no longer does.

WeaponNotAtFault.Title: The Weapon Was Not at Fault
WeaponNotAtFault.Description: At least that much is settled. Unfortunately, the next attack still has to carry the awkward burden of that conclusion.
WeaponNotAtFault.Effect: The Weapon Was Not at Fault

CenterOfGravityReassigned.Title: Center of Gravity Reassigned
CenterOfGravityReassigned.Description: The attack ends with a new and unrequested weight distribution. Precise movement is temporarily optional.

TooMuchCommitment.Title: Too Much Commitment
TooMuchCommitment.Description: The attack receives one hundred percent effort and roughly sixty percent result. The muscles keep records.

BriefSelfCritique.Title: Brief Self-Critique
BriefSelfCritique.Description: For a moment, the entirely reasonable question arises whether that truly was the best available idea.

PlanBUnprepared.Title: There Was a Follow-Through
PlanBUnprepared.Description: The attack continues a little beyond the useful part. Returning to a sensible guard takes noticeably longer.

TempoMisplaced.Title: Tempo Misplaced
TempoMisplaced.Description: Somewhere between windup and outcome, part of the movement flow went missing. It may turn up later.

CorrectionTooLate.Title: Correction Too Late
CorrectionTooLate.Description: The correct evasive movement is identified, unfortunately only after the incorrect one has finished.

UnexpectedPause.Title: Unexpected Pause
UnexpectedPause.Description: The failure interrupts the rhythm thoroughly enough that the next moment requires some reorganization.

ConcentrationOutsourced.Title: Still Thinking About That
ConcentrationOutsourced.Description: The attack is over. The mind has not entirely accepted this and briefly remains occupied with the details.

BreathingWasOptional.Title: Breathing Was Apparently Optional
BreathingWasOptional.Description: The attack demanded everything at once. The lungs would like to point out that they were included in "everything".

GeneralConfidenceReview.Title: That Shook More Than Intended
GeneralConfidenceReview.Description: One bad attack unsettles more than the weapon arm. For a moment, every defensive instinct is slightly less certain.

FormulaWasRight.Title: The Formula Was Right
FormulaWasRight.Description: The magic reaches its target exactly as calculated. The target needs a moment to process this unpleasant academic defeat.

MoreEmphasisThanPlanned.Title: More Emphasis Than Planned
MoreEmphasisThanPlanned.Description: The spell leaves a pronounced magical resonance. Further spells now find the target regrettably receptive.

CleanlyCompiled.Title: Cleanly Compiled
CleanlyCompiled.Description: No visible errors, no embarrassing side effects, not even smoke. The next spell attack benefits from this rare condition.

MagicalDebrief.Title: Lesson Arrives First
MagicalDebrief.Description: The target now understands exactly what went wrong. This knowledge arrives slightly too late to help with the next defense.

NotSubtle.Title: That Was Not Subtle
NotSubtle.Description: The spell makes its point with remarkable clarity. The target briefly takes the rest of the situation more seriously.

SecondaryEffectsIncluded.Title: Secondary Effects Included
SecondaryEffectsIncluded.Description: The spell does what it was meant to do and then, with unnecessary enthusiasm, keeps going. The target's vision briefly objects.

ResidualArcanePressure.Title: Residual Magical Pressure
ResidualArcanePressure.Description: The energy lingers just long enough to leave the target's defense inconveniently untidy.

TheoryWins.Title: Theory Wins
TheoryWins.Description: For one brief and precious moment, practice agrees with the notes. Even the spell DC seems more confident.

Overqualified.Title: Overqualified
Overqualified.Description: The spell solves the problem more thoroughly than required. The caster keeps the small surplus of confidence.

ExcellentExample.Title: Excellent Example
ExcellentExample.Description: If anyone later asks what this is supposed to look like, this would have made a respectable textbook sidebar.

MagicWithFollowThrough.Title: Magic with Follow-Through
MagicWithFollowThrough.Description: The spell ends. Its opinion about the target's mobility apparently does not.

UncomfortablyPersuasive.Title: Uncomfortably Persuasive
UncomfortablyPersuasive.Description: The magical argument leaves a gap in the defense. Nobody is required to be happy about it.

TheoryMeetsPractice.Title: Theory Meets Practice
TheoryMeetsPractice.Description: The meeting is tense. The caster needs a moment to determine which part of the theory just lost.

FeedbackReceived.Title: Feedback Received
FeedbackReceived.Description: The magic provides immediate feedback. Unfortunately, it is technically correct and briefly makes the caster more vulnerable to further spells.

FormulaObjects.Title: Formula with Objections
FormulaObjects.Description: The spell does not merely miss. It leaves the caster briefly uncertain whether the next targeting calculation can be trusted.

ConcentrationWithNoise.Title: Concentration with Background Noise
ConcentrationWithNoise.Description: The mental workspace is suddenly remarkably crowded. Precise magical difficulty suffers briefly.

MagicalHangover.Title: Magical Hangover
MagicalHangover.Description: The spell briefly went somewhere it should not have. The body responds with a very formal complaint.

ShouldGlowDifferently.Title: That Should Glow Differently
ShouldGlowDifferently.Description: The good news: it glows. The less good news: the caster briefly sees worse afterward.

TooFocusedOnDetails.Title: Too Focused on the Details
TooFocusedOnDetails.Description: Attention remains trapped in the failed formula. For a moment, there is simply not enough left for a convincing defense.

ConfidenceShortCircuit.Title: Confidence Short Circuit
ConfidenceShortCircuit.Description: Magic is allowed to be complicated. It simply does not need to make the point this personally.

BacklashNeedsSpace.Title: The Backlash Needs Room
BacklashNeedsSpace.Description: The magic takes up space. The caster briefly has to make do with less movement.

AnotherAttemptLater.Title: Another Attempt. Later.
AnotherAttemptLater.Description: The failure is thorough enough to knock the flow of action out of rhythm for a moment.

MagicRemembers.Title: The Magic Remembers
MagicRemembers.Description: For a brief moment, every further defense feels as though the universe took notes.

OpenQuestions.Title: Open Questions
OpenQuestions.Description: The spell fails, and the stance follows. At least the sequence is clear.

WasThatAll.Title: Was That All?
WasThatAll.Description: The strain arrives, makes its case, and is ignored with physically impressive rudeness.

MoreDurableThanTheory.Title: More Durable Than the Theory
MoreDurableThanTheory.Description: By every reasonable assumption, that should have been worse. The body keeps the difference as reserve.

ComplaintRejected.Title: Not Today
ComplaintRejected.Description: Whatever tried to get through meets a body that has chosen stubbornness as a short-term survival strategy.

SystemStillRunning.Title: The System Is Still Running
SystemStillRunning.Description: Everything important still works. Several parts seem mildly surprised and begin repairs immediately.

SurprisinglyIntact.Title: Surprisingly Intact
SurprisinglyIntact.Description: The body absorbs the strain so cleanly that the next damage briefly has to work harder to make its case.

StableEnough.Title: Stable Enough
StableEnough.Description: The strain barely changes the stance. For the next attack, it even looks remarkably organized.

AdrenalineApproved.Title: Adrenaline Has an Opinion
AdrenalineApproved.Description: The body's answer is immediate and not especially subtle: keep going. The next attack benefits.

ExtraStepAvailable.Title: Another Gear Available
ExtraStepAvailable.Description: Apparently there were still reserves available. Nobody knows why they were not reported earlier.

NotEvenFlinching.Title: Did Not Even Flinch
NotEvenFlinching.Description: That was physically impressive enough that fear briefly decides to try someone else.

ReserveTank.Title: Reserve Buffer
ReserveTank.Description: The strain encounters more substance than expected. The surplus remains briefly available.

UnreasonablyHealthy.Title: Unreasonably Healthy
UnreasonablyHealthy.Description: Physical damage briefly faces an exceptionally poor cost-benefit calculation.

RecoveryAlreadyStarted.Title: Repairs Already Underway
RecoveryAlreadyStarted.Description: The effect is barely over before the body starts post-processing. Efficient, almost suspiciously so.

FormalComplaint.Title: Formal Complaint
FormalComplaint.Description: The body takes the strain personally and expresses its dissatisfaction with remarkable clarity.

StrengthBudgetCut.Title: Used More Than Expected
StrengthBudgetCut.Description: The strain draws deeper on the muscles than expected. For a short while, force comes with a smaller reserve.

NeedAMoment.Title: A Moment, Please
NeedAMoment.Description: The body requests a very brief interruption. The request is approved without consultation.

LegsHaveQuestions.Title: The Legs Have Questions
LegsHaveQuestions.Description: The strain is over, but the legs are not entirely convinced. They proceed with noticeable caution.

FollowUpExam.Title: The Body Remembers
FollowUpExam.Description: Whatever just happened leaves the body distinctly less eager to endure a repeat performance.

GeneralSystemWarning.Title: General System Warning
GeneralSystemWarning.Description: One failure produces a surprising number of warning messages. Temporarily, every defense is affected.

PostureNeedsMaintenance.Title: Posture Requires Maintenance
PostureNeedsMaintenance.Description: The strain leaves the defense visibly less organized than intended.

PowerDeliveryDelayed.Title: Power Delivery Delayed
PowerDeliveryDelayed.Description: The muscles are still occupied with the previous problem. Attacks briefly receive less precise support.

EverythingFeelsWorse.Title: Everything Feels Worse
EverythingFeelsWorse.Description: The strain leaves the body inconveniently receptive to further problems. Very cooperative of it.

PhysicalWarrantyExpired.Title: Everything Has a Tender Spot
PhysicalWarrantyExpired.Description: For a brief moment, ordinary blows keep finding places that are already sore enough to notice.

CoordinationAlsoAffected.Title: Coordination Also Affected
CoordinationAlsoAffected.Description: Apparently the strain was not content with hurting. It also leaves the body's timing briefly out of step.

GuardOnSickLeave.Title: Hands Full Elsewhere
GuardOnSickLeave.Description: Too much attention is busy keeping the body together. The outside guard is briefly less convincing.

ExactlyWhereNotToBe.Title: Exactly Where Not to Be
ExactlyWhereNotToBe.Description: The movement ends in the only sensible place. In hindsight, that is of course completely obvious.

LookedIntentional.Title: Looked Intentional
LookedIntentional.Description: Whether it was planned is beside the point. The new position is defensively excellent.

MomentumRecovered.Title: Momentum Recovered
MomentumRecovered.Description: The evasive movement does not cost rhythm. Surprisingly, it contributes some.

Countertempo.Title: Countertempo
Countertempo.Description: Evasion and counterattack suddenly look suspiciously similar. The next attack benefits.

OneDefenseTeachesAnother.Title: One Defense Teaches Another
OneDefenseTeachesAnother.Description: The perfect movement briefly establishes a very useful pattern for further saving throws.

NearMissReserve.Title: Near-Miss Reserve
NearMissReserve.Description: The effect was close enough to produce adrenaline, but not close enough to dispute the claim to it.

BarelyTouched.Title: Barely Touched
BarelyTouched.Description: The movement briefly reduces the persuasive power of the next damage.

PhysicalGapFound.Title: Physical Gap Found
PhysicalGapFound.Description: The evasive movement finds a position where ordinary physical violence briefly has weaker arguments.

CirculationImproved.Title: Circulation Unexpectedly Helpful
CirculationImproved.Description: The quick movement was apparently not medically useless. The body immediately begins minor repair work.

ConfidenceCatchesUp.Title: Confidence Catches Up
ConfidenceCatchesUp.Description: The mind realizes only afterward how close that was. Until then it considers the whole thing controlled and steadies the will.

BreathingRoomFound.Title: Breathing Room Found
BreathingRoomFound.Description: The movement ends exactly where the body can briefly brace better against the next strain.

AlreadyElsewhere.Title: Already Elsewhere
AlreadyElsewhere.Description: The reflex was so clean that even the next movement starts with a small head start.

WrongDirectionConfirmed.Title: Wrong Direction Confirmed
WrongDirectionConfirmed.Description: The evasive movement begins with complete confidence and is reviewed from the floor.

CorrectionInProgress.Title: Correction in Progress
CorrectionInProgress.Description: The body attempts to evade and cancel the first evasive movement at the same time. Precision suffers.

MomentumFiledElsewhere.Title: Momentum Went Ahead Without You
MomentumFiledElsewhere.Description: The dodge spends more momentum than it returns. The next movement starts with noticeably less of it.

DefenseStillTurning.Title: Defense Still Turning
DefenseStillTurning.Description: The danger has passed, but the body is still finishing the dodge. Guard takes a moment to catch up.

SecondGuessingTheDodge.Title: Second-Guessing the Dodge
SecondGuessingTheDodge.Description: The next reflex begins with a brief internal discussion about the strategy used so far.

HandsStillCatchingUp.Title: The Hands Are Still Catching Up
HandsStillCatchingUp.Description: The movement was disorganized enough that attacks briefly wait for delayed feedback.
HandsStillCatchingUp.Effect: The Hands Are Still Catching Up

GeneralEvasionConcern.Title: One Bad Step Echoes
GeneralEvasionConcern.Description: The failed dodge leaves every defensive instinct slightly out of tune for a moment.

StandingSomewhereTechnically.Title: Technically Still Standing Somewhere
StandingSomewhereTechnically.Description: The position satisfies the minimum geometric requirements. Defensive advantages are not among them.

PauseForRecalculation.Title: Pause for Recalculation
PauseForRecalculation.Description: The movement was wrong enough that the next action briefly has to wait for new coordinates.

VisualDataDelayed.Title: Visual Data Delayed
VisualDataDelayed.Description: The eyes and the rest of the body disagreed slightly about direction. Vision needs a moment.

EverythingFoundTheOpening.Title: Everything Found the Opening
EverythingFoundTheOpening.Description: The failed movement leaves a position where further damage finds follow-up opportunities suspiciously easily.

PhysicsTakesNotes.Title: Physics Takes Notes
PhysicsTakesNotes.Description: Physical hits briefly receive a very clear idea of where they should land.

No.Title: No.
No.Description: The mental dispute ends with remarkable brevity. The will remains steadier for the next request.

NotedAndRejected.Title: Noted and Rejected
NotedAndRejected.Description: The effect receives a complete internal review and still no admission. Other defenses briefly benefit from the clarity.

FearAppointmentCancelled.Title: Fear Appointment Cancelled
FearAppointmentCancelled.Description: After that defense, fear has no available appointment for a short while.

ConfidenceDividend.Title: Confidence to Spare
ConfidenceDividend.Description: The mind wins cleanly enough to have a little certainty left over. The body turns it into temporary resilience.

ArgumentWon.Title: Argument Won
ArgumentWon.Description: The mind is unusually certain of itself. The next attack may benefit from this rare internal agreement.

ComposureRestored.Title: Composure Restored
ComposureRestored.Description: The mental defense is clean enough that even physical guard briefly looks more organized.

MentalNoiseReduced.Title: Mental Noise Reduced
MentalNoiseReduced.Description: The defense briefly creates quiet in the mind. Mental damage has to work harder to make itself heard.

GeneralResolve.Title: General Resolve
GeneralResolve.Description: The mental clarity briefly radiates surprisingly far. Even ordinary damage encounters a little more resistance.

NervesBeginRepairs.Title: The Nerves Begin Repairs
NervesBeginRepairs.Description: The thoughts are orderly enough again that the body apparently begins post-processing immediately.

BodyFollowsMind.Title: The Body Follows the Mind
BodyFollowsMind.Description: The will prevails, and the body's defenses gratefully accept the unusually clear instruction.

ReflexesGetTheMemo.Title: Clarity Reaches the Feet
ReflexesGetTheMemo.Description: For once, thought and motion agree immediately. The reflexes briefly sharpen.

VerySureAboutThis.Title: Very Sure About This
VerySureAboutThis.Description: Confidence is currently unnecessarily high. The body prudently sets aside a little reserve.

ThoughtHadPriority.Title: The Thought Had Priority
ThoughtHadPriority.Description: The foreign influence proceeds with surprising efficiency. The creature's own thoughts briefly need longer to catch up.

UncomfortablyPersuasive.Title: Uncomfortably Persuasive
UncomfortablyPersuasive.Description: The effect makes a point one would rather not have understood. The rest of the situation briefly looks much more threatening.

InternalDebateContinues.Title: Internal Debate Continues
InternalDebateContinues.Description: The effect itself is over. The counterarguments are not. The next Will save suffers for it.

DoubtSpreads.Title: Doubt Spreads
DoubtSpreads.Description: One failed mental defense unfortunately raises questions about every other defensive mechanism.

AttentionElsewhere.Title: Part of You Is Still There
AttentionElsewhere.Description: The effect ends, but some attention stays behind with it. The outside world gets less of your guard.
AttentionElsewhere.Effect: Part of You Is Still There

ThinkingTakesTime.Title: Thinking Takes Time Right Now
ThinkingTakesTime.Description: The thoughts need to put themselves back in the correct order. The flow of action waits for a moment.

AttackNeedsApproval.Title: Too Many Voices, One Attack
AttackNeedsApproval.Description: The mind gives itself competing instructions. The next attack pays for the disagreement.

DefenseForgotten.Title: Defense Briefly Forgotten
DefenseForgotten.Description: The mental strain consumes more attention than planned. Guard becomes slightly careless on the side.

FeetAwaitInstructions.Title: Hesitation Reaches the Feet
FeetAwaitInstructions.Description: The mind stalls just long enough for movement to lose some urgency.

MentalDoorLeftOpen.Title: Mental Door Left Open
MentalDoorLeftOpen.Description: The effect leaves an inconveniently well-marked entry point for further mental damage.

MindBodySchedulingConflict.Title: Mind and Body Disagree on Timing
MindBodySchedulingConflict.Description: Thought and movement do not arrive at quite the same time. Coordination briefly suffers.
MindBodySchedulingConflict.Effect: Mind and Body Disagree on Timing

PsychicNausea.Title: Psychic Nausea
PsychicNausea.Description: Some thoughts sit more heavily in the stomach than their purely mental nature would suggest.
